Real pf2e 8.5.0 equipment and treasure documents, copied unchanged from
`packs/pf2e/equipment/` at tag `pf2e-8.5.0` (fetched 2026-10-29). They are the
classification fixtures for tests/treasure-permanent.test.mjs and
tests/parcel.permanentPool.test.mjs:

- magical-hearing-aid: level 1, magical, worn, no rules (eligible at level 1)
- cube-of-recall: level 19, magical, no rules (eligible at level 19)
- aerial-cloak: level 3, magical, invested, two Rule Elements (rejected by the document check)
- abysium-chunk: level 0, precious only, rarity rare (mundane, not magical)
- flaming: level 8, usage etched-onto-a-weapon (a fundamental rune, an attachment)
- magic-wand-1st-rank-spell: a generic wand template (consumable, category wand, level 3)
- wand-of-mercy-1st-rank: a special published wand (trait wand)
- poisonous-cloak-type-i: rare, cursed, invested, no price (cursed)
- taletellers-ring: cursed item (cursed)
- agate: treasure, category gem, 5 sp (valuable)
- silk-ceremonial-armor: treasure, category art-object, 10 gp (valuable)
